mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the reflex pathways to the body was most worthwhile: the planned views link head movement to steadier vision and posture rather than leaving the anatomy as an isolated diagram.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the two completed sensor types into one set felt mostly like assembly; its result added little explanation beyond their location beside the cochlea.

surprise.text: The otolith-organ comparison usefully distinguishes the start of straight-line motion from steady motion, alongside sensing gravity.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the term 'otolith organs' appeared without an explicit definition; the weighted-membrane picture helped clarify what they are.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the final reflex connection made the anatomical construction relevant to an everyday experience, though the intervening assembly was predictable.
